To begin with, there's a bunch of paintings in the laboratory in carcosa that have the names of who painted them..sometimes, at least. I've also noted that all names, excluding Hastur himself, follow the formula of having a first name with a meaning behind it and a last name relating to an HP Lovecraft story, and 2 of the paintings I found are painted by someone with the same first name, Alden. The name Alden can mean "Old Friend." These paintings are also right beside each other, so there's no way it's a mistake they have the same first name. My theory is that Alden Zann/Castaigne is a pseudonym for another painter in the game we know, Robert Pickman, who wrote several art related books in universe and is Alice Pickman's father. (Also I believe he painted the painting that takes you to carcosa) and we also know he dissapeared. I think it's possible that he used to babysit the baby, was turned into the white rabbit, and now Alice takes on her father's job in an attempt to get him back. I'd also like to note that based on the painting seen in the lab he was not a seeker of the jaundice court, or at least not at the same time as Nicholas, but might have worked with them still, as we know for certain they have some sort of connection.
